input.brief: Settings window of CodeKiln, a local-first desktop AI coding workbench: model providers and model routing for the agent sessions.
screens: 模型中心 · 服务商与模型路由
外观 · 主题与界面密度

stated.mood: current desktop settings page, tidy dev tool, dense but calm
stated.emphasis: model providers and which model answers by default

preferences.question: 颜色、字体、字号怎么处理？
preferences.answer: 跟随应用现有主题：深色 #141416 面板、品牌橙 #f2581b、Inter / Inter Tight、现有字号层级；这次只改布局风格，不改视觉语言。

preferences.question: 布局重点是什么？
preferences.answer: 把模型槽位（默认/标题总结/代审/子代理/虚拟模型）从五段独立堆叠合成一块可扫读的结构，让宽屏宽度被真正用上：标签与控件左右分栏、操作按钮跟随各自区块、层级分组替代长串 40px 空白的横线。

preferences.question: 这次做哪些页面？
preferences.answer: 以模型中心为主，另加一页外观设置，用来验证同一套 shell 在次级页也成立。

obvious: Dark #141416 panel, 240px sidebar of 16 flat category rows with an orange-tinted active pill, one scrolling column: each section is an 18px heading + one grey line + the control underneath, hairlines between sections, every block the same weight, Inter everywhere, orange toggles.

proposals.name: 调度台
proposals.idea: On these screens, the four model slots (默认 / 标题 / 代审 / 子代理) plus the virtual router become a routing table — a dispatch board where each role row names the model that answers it, its context and what happens when that model is down.
proposals.departs: The obvious build stacks each setting as a full-width block with a 1100px gap between a heading and its own toggle. Here the roles are one table: role on the left edge, model · context · fallback aligned in columns, so five settings become one glanceable object; the category list shrinks to a 56px rail to give the table the width.
proposals.layout: 56px icon rail for the 16 categories, then the panel splits: a 940px routing table (role × model × fallback) with the provider inventory as a 320px column on the right holding health dot, port and model count. The first screen's largest element is the default-model row; the single accent appears only on the live/selected state.

devices.reason: model ids, ports and context sizes sit in aligned columns; proportional digits break the vertical line the table depends on

proposals.name: 名册 · 表单
proposals.idea: On these screens, the product's own rule that a change binds to new sessions ('新会话生效') becomes the spine: every row carries the scope it binds to on its left, so the page reads like an inventory sheet — what it is, what it does, when it takes effect — instead of a stack of anonymous cards.
proposals.departs: Light paper ground instead of the app's dark one, a geometric display face instead of Inter, grouped and labelled navigation instead of 16 identical pills, and label-left / control-right form rows instead of heading-above-control stacks — the page gets shorter by half and each row's state is readable from one horizontal scan.
proposals.layout: 248px sidebar with five grouped labels (通用 / 界面 / 模型 / 扩展 / 系统) and a 960px form column: 34% label with its scope note, 66% control, 60-72px rows, sections separated by space alone, one 2px accent rule under the page title.

devices.reason: model ids and ports are data, not prose; monospace keeps 127.0.0.1:3425 and reasoning effort marks from reflowing between rows

proposals.name: 窑口 · 检查器
proposals.idea: On these screens, the local daemon at 127.0.0.1:3425 becomes the first object on the page — a live service tile with port, model count and health — and a persistent right-hand inspector states what the change you are about to make does to the next session.
proposals.departs: A heavy display masthead and a teal accent instead of a quiet Inter title and orange; the category list becomes a searchable index with a one-line description per entry; and the right inspector column replaces hairlines as the thing that separates blocks.
proposals.layout: 300px searchable index (name + one grey line each) · 700px roster column led by the local-service tile, then providers, then the four model slots · 320px inspector holding session scope, health and usage. Masthead '模型中心' at 34px heavy with the count of enabled providers beside it.

devices.reason: the service tile is built from a port, a path and a model count; monospace makes the address read as an address
